title: Shared equilibrium state with system-role Views
hypothesis: A shared simultaneous forecaster with small system-role Views predicts heldout multi-system trajectories at lower complete bytes and compute than independent system forecasters, with an advantage beyond native system embeddings.

world.shared_equilibrium: common mean state plus role-specific linear perturbation
world.evaluation: score the last two system IDs separately; their role codes remain deployed in the payload, so this is not unseen-system generalization

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed on native embedding alias or byte/quality gate miss.

controls: Mirror role code over shared transition
success_gate: heldout rollout nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent, no worse than native embedding compute, and strict Mirror gain over native embedding.
failure_gate: FAIL if native embedding/low-rank role code matches Mirror or quality/storage gate misses.

compute.stability: report spectral radius and horizon error

boundaries: Synthetic linear forecasting only; no ESE model, foundation forecasting, or real-system claim.
System IDs are known; no identity inference claim.
No fresh worlds after development gate failure or exact native alias.
